Overview
The WHO Procurement Report is published annually and provides an overview of procurement at WHO, details essential procurement data for the year, and showcases key initiatives and highlights. This report is produced in line with WHO’s commitment to transparency and for the benefit of WHO Member States, donors, partners, WHO staff, the supplier community and other stakeholders.
